description: This file defines the LoanCollateralTemplateData class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent collateral information associated with a loan, including identifiers, pricing, quantities, and related collateral details. It includes a factory method for creating instances from ClientCollateralManagement objects.

classes.name: LoanCollateralTemplateData
classes.description: A data transfer object encapsulating collateral details such as collateral ID, base price, percentage to base, quantity, and name, with a static factory method for instantiation from ClientCollateralManagement instances.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Static factory method to create a LoanCollateralTemplateData instance from a ClientCollateralManagement object.
